name: Single Strike & Rapid Strike Premium Trainer Boxes

releases.name: Single Strike & Rapid Strike Premium Trainer Boxes

description.text: Premium Trainer Box ICHIGEKI and Premium Trainer Box RENGEKI, released together on 22 January 2021 with the Single Strike Master and Rapid Strike Master expansions. Each held 15 packs of its expansion and 157 cards of 34 kinds for building decks, with reprints from the Sun & Moon series among them, each led by a specially illustrated Single Strike or Rapid Strike Urshifu V with its Strike Energy. Acrylic damage counters, Poison and Burn markers, a damage counter case, a coin and a card box came with each. This set holds the fixed cards of both boxes.
